newsitem.title: USA: XATA to repurchase common stock.
newsitem.headline: XATA to repurchase common stock.

text.p: XATA Corp said Tuesday its board authorized the company to repurchase up to $1.0 million in common stock from time to time in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions.

Repurchased shares will be added to the company's treasury shares. They will be used to offset the dilutive effects of shares issued in connection with certain employment agreements and for the company's compensation and benefit plans.
Dennis Johnson, president, said XATA believes its shares are undervalued and represent an attractive investment opportunity at current price levels. XATA shares closed Monday at four.
As of March 31, XATA had about 4.5 million shares outstanding.
XATA supplies logistics systems and solutions to the transportation and distribution segments of the fleet trucking industry.
